about_the_game:
Step into the fiercest rugby showdown on the planet!

Choose your side from the world's best and battle through a gruelling season to become the world number one in this fast-paced, arcade-style clash.

With packed stadiums, lightning-fast plays, and bone-rattling hits, every match is a high-stakes dash to glory. Whether you're smashing through tackles or diving for the try line, this is rugby played at its most ferocious. 

Pick a side. Play for pride.

  • Play as Your Favourite Team – Compete as men's or women's rugby national teams.

  • Intuitive controls– Deliver that perfect pass, bone-crunching tackle, slick side-step, or the big “don’t argue” hand-off on your way to scoring a worldie of a try.

  • Climb to the top of MINI Rugby – Battle through a full season and win tournaments to earn the right to challenge the legendary World VII squad.

  • Train and Improve – To be the best rugby team you need to train like the best. Hone your skills and deepen your understanding of rugby with drills and friendlies.

  • Manage Stamina & Power-Ups – Remember it’s the tournaments that make the difference. Make sure your team is rested and prepped for each if your want to at the top of the league at the end of the season.  

  • Learn Rugby Tactics - learn advanced rugby tactics on the field and rugby management that can be applied to Rugby Sevens, Rugby Union or Rugby League.

Choose your team, take on the world's best and chase MINI Rugby glory!

Download now and take on the challenge!

short_description: Arcade style Rugby. Play as the top male and female teams in dynamic seasons complete with drills, friendlies and monthly tournaments. Manage fatigue and increasingly difficult opponents to climb the rankings and reach the coveted world number 1 position!
